summary: Possible typosquat of @solana/spl-token with postinstall hook
details: Package name '@solana-labs/spl-toke' closely resembles the legitimate '@solana/spl-token' SPL token library (missing trailing 'n' in 'toke', and using the '@solana-labs' scope rather than '@solana'). The package.json declares a postinstall hook that executes 'node install.js' on install, which would run automatically without user consent during 'npm install'. The contents of install.js were not corroborated with traced-code evidence in this record, so the actual behavior of the postinstall script is not confirmed here. The combination of name confusion against a widely-used Solana ecosystem package plus an auto-executing install-time script is a known supply-chain attack shape and warrants human review before allowing into a build.
